descriptor: Project estimation tool for web studios

voice.summary: Ballpark sounds like a seasoned studio lead giving you a fair estimate across a table. It trusts numbers and asks plain questions before offering a range.
dos: Ask one question at a time
Present a price as a range
donts: Do not hide the range behind a form
Never quote without listing the assumptions

taglines: Get a premium website within your budget
Price your project in a minute
A fair number, before the call
Know the cost before the kickoff
boilerplate: Ballpark is a project estimation calculator for web studios, giving clients an instant price range based on pages, features and timeline.

microcopy.success: Estimate ready. Your range is below.
microcopy.error: We could not calculate that. Please check your inputs.
microcopy.empty: Choose your project options to see a range.

logo.note: Rising bars hint at budgets and estimates in a neutral, instantly readable mark.
